records.title: Amgueddfa Cymru: Early Medieval human remains, item 95.56H/1.93
records.description: Amgueddfa Cymru – Museum Wales catalogue entry for human remains, item 95.56H/1.93, associated with the 1994 excavation at Great House Farm, Llandough. The page describes skeletal elements, a wooden coffin and stratigraphic placement, and records a donation on 28 July 1994.
records.transcript:
Early Medieval human remains

Item Number: 95.56H/1.93

Description: Near complete skeleton, missing L radius, and one fibula. Possible osteoarthritis in feet. Additional L talus, L patella, R ulna, radius fragment, scapula fragment and clavicle fragments are from another individual.

Find Information:
Site Name: Great House Farm, Llandough
Collection Method: Excavation
Date: 1994
Notes: Wooden coffin. Above Sk110, below Sk69. Arms both crossed on pelvis, legs straight.

Acquisition: donation, 28/7/1994
Should any artefacts be placed on display in any museum, then Ideal Homes Wales Ltd. should be acknowledged as the donor.

Material: Bone
records.transcript_status: Direct transcription of the public catalogue entry, checked 15 November 2026; the underlying object, report or archive unit has not been inspected.
records.interpretation: The Museum catalogue associates this human-remains accession with the Great House Farm, Llandough excavation and records the stated coffin and stratigraphic context. It is an object-level archaeological catalogue entry, not evidence of ownership or title. The full excavation report and object have not been inspected.
